insurer: TATA AIG General Insurance Company Limited
plan_name: Model Policy for Persons with Disabilities and HIV/AIDS

room_rent.note: Proportionate deduction on associated medical expenses if higher room taken

icu.note: ICU/ICCU charges capped at 2% of sum insured per day

copayment.note: Mandatory 20% co-payment applies to every admissible claim

sub_limits.note: Cataract capped at ₹40,000 per eye per year; modern treatments capped at 50% of SI

ped_waiting.note: 24 months for pre-existing disability; 36 months for all other pre-existing conditions and HIV/AIDS

specific_disease_waiting.note: Applies to listed conditions including cataract, hernia, ENT disorders, etc.

maternity.note: Maternity expenses explicitly excluded (Excl18); ectopic pregnancy covered

cumulative_bonus.note: No cumulative/no-claim bonus mentioned in policy wording

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in policy wording

day_care.note: Indicative list of 500+ day-care procedures provided in Annexure III

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation explicitly excluded under specific exclusions

ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH treatment covered up to full sum insured per policy year

organ_donor.note: Hospitalisation for donation of body organs by insured explicitly excluded

ambulance.note: Road ambulance reimbursement capped at ₹2,000 per hospitalisation

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments covered up to 50% of sum insured

consumables.note: Consumables (gloves, etc.) listed as non-payable items in Annexure II

global_cover.note: Medical treatment outside India explicitly excluded

moratorium.note: After 5 continuous years no claim contestable except fraud

grace_period.note: 30 days for yearly premium; 15 days for half-yearly/quarterly per Table of Benefits; 30 days per Section 9.1 for half-yearly/quarterly

free_look.note: From date of receipt of policy document

portability.note: Portability as per IRDAI guidelines; waiting period credits transferred

notable_exclusions: Anti-retroviral therapy (ART) costs, domiciliary treatment, OPD, STDs/venereal disease, prosthetics/devices for disability, treatment outside India, stem cell storage
